assessment_summary: In Proof 1 Necessary Condition, line 0041 contains a typo in the commutative diagram. The arrow from `G \tuple{-, D}(C)` to `G \tuple{-, D}(C')` (labeled as `"GCD";"GC2D"`) is incorrectly labeled as `\map {F \tuple{-, D} } f`. It should be `\map {G \tuple{-, D} } f`. This makes the diagram mathematically incorrect, so the step is invalid.
